name: kokkos
description: Kokkos C++ Performance Portability Programming Ecosystem. Overlay port for OpenSWMM: Serial + OpenMP host backends by default (Phase 1); the optional `cuda` (Phase 2), `rocm`, and `sycl` (Phase 5) features build the CUDA/HIP/SYCL device backends.

cuda.description: Build the Kokkos CUDA device backend (Phase 2). Requires the CUDA toolkit and the target GPU arch via the OPENSWMM_KOKKOS_CUDA_ARCH env var (a Kokkos_ARCH_* suffix, e.g. AMPERE80). Not buildable on macOS.

rocm.description: Build the Kokkos HIP device backend (Phase 5, AMD). Requires ROCm/hipcc and the target GPU arch via the OPENSWMM_KOKKOS_HIP_ARCH env var (a Kokkos_ARCH_* suffix, e.g. AMD_GFX90A). Not buildable on macOS.

sycl.description: Build the Kokkos SYCL device backend (Phase 5, Intel). Requires the oneAPI toolkit/icpx and the target GPU arch via the OPENSWMM_KOKKOS_SYCL_ARCH env var (a Kokkos_ARCH_* suffix, e.g. INTEL_PVC). Not buildable on macOS.
